description: This file contains end-to-end test functions for command management in the Mattermost project, including listing, archiving, modifying, and showing commands, with various permission and existence scenarios.

classes.name: MmctlE2ETestSuite
classes.description: Test suite struct for end-to-end testing of command functionalities in Mattermost.

methods.name: TestListCommandCmd
methods.description: Tests listing commands for non-existing, specific, all, and unauthorized teams.

methods.name: TestArchiveCommandCmdF
methods.description: Tests archiving commands, including non-existent, existing, and permission-restricted cases.

methods.name: TestModifyCommandCmdF
methods.description: Tests modifying commands, including successful updates, non-existent commands, and invalid trigger words.

methods.name: TestShowCommandCmdF
methods.description: Tests showing commands by ID and team:trigger, including non-existent commands.
